protectedConstraints: app-owned browser profile and render surface
user can use other phone apps
no Termux, ADB, port or IP setup in normal use
explicit actions do not require repetitive confirmation
candidateRuntime: Android WebView Chromium on an app-owned VirtualDisplay and Presentation. It is a candidate, not full browser-parity certification.
completionRule: No product COMPLETE claim until required runtime, wake, media, target-device and client integration gates pass. A build or mock device is not physical evidence. Unfinished target capabilities stay in the backlog and are not removed.
replanTriggers: virtual display stops rendering when app is backgrounded
WebView browser compatibility fails required sites
target host does not ingest MCP audio
